3963:+/-!
3964:+# Reshuffling products of finitely supported laws
3965:+
3966:+The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma produces its six independent
3967:+generating blocks in one grouping, while the restricted line-point laws that
3968:+the projected marginals must match present the same six blocks in another
3969:+grouping.  This module records the rewriting rules that pass between two such
3970:+presentations: the support and the weight of a product, the fact that a
3971:+push-forward along a bijection is determined by the supports and weights it
3972:+compares, and the push-forward of the second factor of a product.
3973:+
3974:+## References
3975:+
3976:+The rewriting rules support `lem:qld-sublines` in
3977:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
3978:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
3979:+The product operation is that of blueprint
3980:+`def:line-point-dist`.
3982:+
3983:+open scoped BigOperators
3984:+
3985:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
3986:+
3987:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
3988:+
3989:+noncomputable section
3990:+
3991:+/-! ## The support and the weight of a product -/
3992:+
3993:+/-- The support of a product law is the product of the supports.  Blueprint
3994:+`def:line-point-dist`, paper
3995:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
3997:+theorem Distribution.prod_support {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
3998:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) :
3999:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).support = μ.support ×ˢ ν.support := rfl
4000:+
4001:+/-- The weight of a product law is the product of the weights.  Blueprint
4002:+`def:line-point-dist`, paper
4003:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
4005:+theorem Distribution.prod_weight {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4006:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (w : α × β) :
4007:+    (Distribution.prod μ ν).weight w = μ.weight w.1 * ν.weight w.2 := rfl
4008:+
4009:+/-! ## Push-forward along a bijection -/
4010:+
4011:+/-- A push-forward along a bijection is identified by the supports and the
4012:+weights it compares: if the map matches the two supports and carries each
4013:+weight to the corresponding weight, and if it has a two-sided inverse, the
4014:+push-forward is the target law.  Blueprint
4015:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4016:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4017:+theorem Distribution.map_bijective_eq {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4018:+    [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) (f : α → β)
4019:+    (g : β → α) (hgf : ∀ a, g (f a) = a) (hfg : ∀ b, f (g b) = b)
4020:+    (hs : ∀ a, a ∈ μ.support ↔ f a ∈ ν.support)
4021:+    (hw : ∀ a, μ.weight a = ν.weight (f a)) :
4022:+    μ.map f = ν := by
4023:+  classical
4024:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
4025:+  · rw [Distribution.map_support]
4026:+    ext b
4027:+    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
4028:+    constructor
4029:+    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
4030:+      exact (hs a).mp ha
4031:+    · intro hb
4032:+      refine ⟨g b, (hs (g b)).mpr ?_, hfg b⟩
4033:+      rw [hfg b]
4034:+      exact hb
4035:+  · funext b
4036:+    rw [Distribution.map_weight]
4037:+    have hfilter : μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = b) =
4038:+        μ.support.filter (fun a => a = g b) := by
4039:+      ext a
4040:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
4041:+      constructor
4042:+      · rintro ⟨ha, h⟩
4043:+        exact ⟨ha, by rw [← h, hgf]⟩
4044:+      · rintro ⟨ha, h⟩
4045:+        exact ⟨ha, by rw [h, hfg]⟩
4046:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.filter_eq' μ.support (g b)]
4047:+    by_cases hmem : g b ∈ μ.support
4048:+    · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton, hw (g b), hfg]
4049:+    · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty]
4050:+      refine (ν.outsideSupport b ?_).symm
4051:+      intro hb
4052:+      exact hmem ((hs (g b)).mpr (by rw [hfg b]; exact hb))
4053:+
4054:+/-! ## Push-forward of the second factor of a product -/
4055:+
4056:+/-- Pushing the second factor of a product forward is pushing the product
4057:+forward along the map acting on that factor alone.  Blueprint
4058:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4059:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4060:+theorem Distribution.prod_map_right {α β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
4061:+    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
4062:+    (g : β → γ) :
4063:+    Distribution.prod μ (ν.map g) =
4064:+      (Distribution.prod μ ν).map (fun w => (w.1, g w.2)) := by
4065:+  classical
4066:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
4067:+  · change μ.support ×ˢ (ν.support.image g) =
4068:+      (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).image (fun w => (w.1, g w.2))
4069:+    ext w
4070:+    obtain ⟨x, c⟩ := w
4071:+    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
4072:+    constructor
4073:+    · rintro ⟨hx, b, hb, rfl⟩
4074:+      exact ⟨x, b, ⟨hx, hb⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
4075:+    · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
4076:+      exact ⟨ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
4077:+  · funext w
4078:+    obtain ⟨x, c⟩ := w
4079:+    have hfilter :
4080:+        (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (p.1, g p.2) = (x, c)) =
4081:+          (μ.support.filter (fun a => a = x)) ×ˢ
4082:+            (ν.support.filter (fun b => g b = c)) := by
4083:+      ext p
4084:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Prod.mk.injEq]
4085:+      tauto
4086:+    have hx : ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter (fun a => a = x), μ.weight a =
4087:+        μ.weight x := by
4088:+      rw [Finset.filter_eq' μ.support x]
4089:+      by_cases hmem : x ∈ μ.support
4090:+      · rw [if_pos hmem, Finset.sum_singleton]
4091:+      · rw [if_neg hmem, Finset.sum_empty, μ.outsideSupport x hmem]
4092:+    change μ.weight x * (ν.map g).weight c =
4093:+      ∑ p ∈ (μ.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter (fun p => (p.1, g p.2) = (x, c)),
4094:+        μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2
4095:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_product,
4096:+      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ =>
4097:+        (Finset.mul_sum (ν.support.filter (fun b => g b = c))
4098:+          (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm),
4099:+      ← Finset.sum_mul, hx]
4100:+    rfl
4101:+
4102:+end
4103:+
4104:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

4114:+/-!
4115:+# The projected marginals of the sub-line law
4116:+
4117:+This module identifies the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law
4118:+of `lem:qld-sublines` as mixtures of the restricted product laws.  The two
4119:+source lines of a sampled triple depend on the drawn extended point only
4120:+through the canonical representatives of its two source blocks, and those
4121:+representatives are unchanged when the drawn point is replaced by any point of
4122:+the extended line; a uniform point of the extended line through a uniform
4123:+point is a uniform point, so the drawn point may be replaced throughout by the
4124:+point that is finally retained.  The six generating blocks of the resulting
4125:+law -- the two source point blocks, the two scalar seeds and the two source
4126:+direction blocks -- are then regrouped into the two restricted product laws
4127:+carried by the two indices of the branch.
4128:+
4129:+## References
4130:+
4131:+The identification is the last step of the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
4132:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4133:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4134:+The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
4135:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
4137:+
4138:+open scoped BigOperators
4139:+

4141:+
4142:+open MIPStarRE.LDT

4144:+noncomputable section

4146:+/-! ## Source lines depend on the point block only through its representative -/

4148:+/-- Two source lines of the same branch with the same seed and the same source
4149:+direction block agree as soon as their point blocks have the same canonical
4150:+representative in the direction of that line.  Blueprint
4151:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4152:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/

4159:+        (subLineSourceDirection P kind (chiIndex P.toLdParams s) d) b') :

4164:+

4675:+# Generating laws of the restricted line-point distributions
4676:+
4677:+This module rewrites the two restricted line-point laws of
4678:+`def:ith-restricted-line` as push-forwards of a single uniformly sampled
4679:+low-degree vector conditioned on the coordinate-index fiber of its retained
4680:+scalar seed.  In that form the point block, the seed and the direction block
4681:+of the sampled vector are visibly the independent generating data of the
4682:+restricted law, which is the description used by the sampling procedure of the
4683:+sub-line lemma: there the projected pairs are built either from a direction
4684:+block inherited from the extended line or from freshly sampled data, and each
4685:+is asserted to follow a restricted law.
4686:+
4687:+## References
4688:+
4689:+The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
4690:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4691:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4692:+The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
4693:+1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.

4704:+/-! ## Restriction of a push-forward -/
4705:+
4706:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: restricting a push-forward distribution to a
4707:+decidable event is the push-forward of the restriction to the pre-image of
4708:+that event.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
4709:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
4710:+theorem Distribution.restrict_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
4711:+    (μ : Distribution α) (f : α → β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
4712:+    (q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred q] (hq : ∀ a, q a ↔ p (f a))
4713:+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b)
4714:+    (hpos' : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a) :
4715:+    Distribution.restrict (μ.map f) p hpos =
4716:+      (Distribution.restrict μ q hpos').map f := by
4717:+  classical
4718:+  have hfiber : ∀ b : β, p b →
4719:+      μ.support.filter (fun a => f a = b) =
4720:+        (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b) := by
4721:+    intro b hb
4722:+    ext a
4723:+    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
4724:+    constructor
4725:+    · rintro ⟨ha, hab⟩
4726:+      exact ⟨⟨ha, (hq a).mpr (hab ▸ hb)⟩, hab⟩
4727:+    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, -⟩, hab⟩
4728:+      exact ⟨ha, hab⟩
4729:+  have himg : (μ.map f).support.filter p = (μ.support.filter q).image f := by
4730:+    ext b
4731:+    simp only [Distribution.map_support, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_image]
4732:+    constructor
4733:+    · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hpb⟩
4734:+      exact ⟨a, ⟨ha, (hq a).mpr hpb⟩, rfl⟩
4735:+    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨ha1, ha2⟩, rfl⟩
4736:+      exact ⟨⟨a, ha1, rfl⟩, (hq a).mp ha2⟩
4737:+  have hmass : (∑ b ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight b) =
4738:+      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight a := by
4739:+    rw [himg]
4740:+    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
4741:+      (s := μ.support.filter q) (t := (μ.support.filter q).image f)
4742:+      (g := f) (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f ha) μ.weight]
4743:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
4744:+    obtain ⟨a0, ha0, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
4745:+    rw [Distribution.map_weight,
4746:+      hfiber _ ((hq a0).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha0).2)]
4747:+  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
4748:+  · exact himg
4749:+  · funext b
4750:+    show (if p b then (μ.map f).weight b /
4751:+        ∑ c ∈ (μ.map f).support.filter p, (μ.map f).weight c else 0) =
4752:+      ∑ a ∈ (μ.support.filter q).filter (fun a => f a = b),
4753:+        (if q a then μ.weight a / ∑ c ∈ μ.support.filter q, μ.weight c else 0)
4754:+    by_cases hb : p b
4755:+    · rw [if_pos hb, hmass, Distribution.map_weight, hfiber b hb,
4756:+        Finset.sum_div]
4757:+      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
4758:+      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1).2]
4759:+    · rw [if_neg hb]
4760:+      refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_).symm
4761:+      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
4762:+      exact absurd (ha2 ▸ (hq a).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha1).2) hb

4766:+/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on the single
4767:+uniformly sampled low-degree vector that generates the line-point laws.

4780:+/-- The coordinate-index event has positive mass under the uniform law on
4781:+low-degree vectors, so the conditioning below is normalized.  Blueprint

4783:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/

4789:+  refine Finset.sum_pos'
4790:+    (fun a _ => (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).nonnegative a)
4791:+    ⟨(fun _ => seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩),

4793:+  · show chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i ⟨0, L.seedFiberCard_pos⟩) = i
4794:+    exact chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue L i _
4795:+  · simp only [uniformDistribution, Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight,
4796:+      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

4930:+/-!
4931:+# Uniformity under the identification of the two scalar fields
4932:+
4933:+The extended line of the sub-line construction lives over the scalar field of
4934:+the directly indexed extended game, while the two source lines live over the
4935:+scalar field of the Pauli basis test.  The two fields are identified
4936:+coordinatewise by a field isomorphism, so that identification is a bijection
4937:+of the coordinate spaces and therefore carries uniform laws to uniform laws.
4938:+This module records that transport for a whole extended point and for the two
4939:+source blocks of an extended point, and it records the resampling rule that
4940:+reading a function at the point of a uniformly random affine parameter on the
4941:+line through the canonical representative of a uniformly random point is the
4942:+same as reading that function at a uniformly random point.
4943:+
4944:+## References
4945:+
4946:+The statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
4947:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
4948:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
4949:+The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
4950:+445--480, paper lines 970--989.
4952:+
4953:+open scoped BigOperators
4954:+
4955:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
4956:+
4957:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
4958:+
4959:+noncomputable section
4960:+
4961:+/-! ## The identification of the two scalar fields as a bijection -/
4962:+
4963:+/-- The coordinatewise identification of the extended scalar field with the
4964:+source scalar field on one source block, presented as a bijection.  Blueprint
4965:+`def:combine-map`, paper
4966:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
4967:+noncomputable def directBlockToPauliEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
4968:+    (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃ (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) where
4969:+  toFun v := fun i => extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (v i)
4970:+  invFun v := fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm (v i)
4971:+  left_inv v := by
4972:+    funext i
4973:+    simp
4974:+  right_inv v := by
4975:+    funext i
4976:+    simp
4977:+
4978:+/-- The coordinatewise identification of the extended scalar field with the
4979:+source scalar field on a whole extended point, presented as a bijection.
4980:+Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
4981:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
4982:+noncomputable def directPointToPauliEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
4983:+    (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃
4984:+      (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) where
4985:+  toFun := directPointToPauli P
4986:+  invFun v := fun i => (extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm (v i)
4987:+  left_inv v := by
4988:+    funext i
4989:+    simp [directPointToPauli]
4990:+  right_inv v := by
4991:+    funext i
4992:+    simp [directPointToPauli]
4993:+
4994:+/-- The `X` block of a transported extended point is the transport of its `X`
4995:+block.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
4996:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
4997:+theorem projX_directPointToPauli_eq (P : AdmissibleParams)
4998:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
4999:+    projX (directPointToPauli P u) = directBlockToPauliEquiv P (projX u) := rfl
5000:+
5001:+/-- The `Z` block of a transported extended point is the transport of its `Z`
5002:+block.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
5003:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
5004:+theorem projZ_directPointToPauli_eq (P : AdmissibleParams)
5005:+    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
5006:+    projZ (directPointToPauli P u) = directBlockToPauliEquiv P (projZ u) := rfl
5007:+
5008:+/-! ## Transport of the uniform laws -/
5009:+
5010:+/-- A uniformly random extended point transported to the source scalar field
5011:+is uniformly random.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5012:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5013:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_directPointToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams) :
5014:+    (uniformDistribution
5015:+          (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
5016:+        (directPointToPauli P) =
5017:+      uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) :=
5018:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv (directPointToPauliEquiv P)
5019:+
5020:+/-- A uniformly random source block transported to the source scalar field is
5021:+uniformly random.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5022:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5023:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_directBlockToPauli (P : AdmissibleParams) :
5024:+    (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
5025:+        (fun v => directBlockToPauliEquiv P v) =
5026:+      uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :=
5027:+  uniformDistribution_map_equiv (directBlockToPauliEquiv P)
5028:+
5029:+/-- The two source blocks of a uniformly random extended point, read in the
5030:+source scalar field, are independent and uniformly random.  Blueprint
5031:+`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5032:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5033:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ_pauli (P : AdmissibleParams) :
5034:+    (uniformDistribution
5035:+          (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)).map
5036:+        (fun u => (projX (directPointToPauli P u),
5037:+          projZ (directPointToPauli P u))) =
5038:+      Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
5039:+        (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)) := by
5040:+  classical
5041:+  have hfun :
5042:+      (fun u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd =>
5043:+          (projX (directPointToPauli P u), projZ (directPointToPauli P u))) =
5044:+        fun u => (Equiv.prodCongr (directBlockToPauliEquiv P)
5045:+          (directBlockToPauliEquiv P)) (projX u, projZ u) := rfl
5046:+  rw [hfun, ← Distribution.map_map _ (fun u => (projX u, projZ u)),
5047:+    uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ, ← uniformDistribution_prod,
5048:+    uniformDistribution_map_equiv, uniformDistribution_prod]
5049:+
5050:+/-! ## Resampling a uniform point along a line -/
5051:+
5052:+/-- Reading a function at the point of a uniformly random affine parameter on
5053:+the line through the canonical representative, in a fixed direction, of a
5054:+uniformly random point is the same as reading that function at a uniformly
5055:+random point.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5056:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5057:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul_comp {K : Type*} [Field K]
5058:+    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] {m : ℕ} {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]
5059:+    (v : Fin m → K) (g : (Fin m → K) → γ) :
5060:+    (Distribution.prod (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
5061:+          (uniformDistribution K)).map
5062:+        (fun w => g (lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v)) =
5063:+      (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K)).map g := by
5064:+  classical
5065:+  rw [← uniformDistribution_prod,
5066:+    ← Distribution.map_map _ (fun w : (Fin m → K) × K =>
5067:+      lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v) g,
5068:+    uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul]
5069:+
5070:+end
5071:+
5072:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

5080:+
5081:+/-!
5082:+# Uniform points of a line and the blocks of a coordinate direction
5083:+
5084:+This module records the two elementary geometric inputs of the sampling
5085:+procedure of the sub-line lemma.  First, a uniformly random point of the
5086:+coordinate space is the same thing as a uniformly random canonical
5087:+representative together with a uniformly random affine parameter along the
5088:+direction: the map sending a pair to the point at that parameter on the line
5089:+through the representative has constant fibers of size `q`, because the
5090:+kernel of the canonical representative map is the span of the direction and
5091:+for the zero direction that map is the identity.  Second, the two coordinate
5092:+blocks of an elementary coordinate direction of the extended space are the
5093:+corresponding elementary direction of the source space in the block that
5094:+carries the coordinate, and zero in the other block and at the two scalar
5095:+coordinates.
5096:+
5097:+## References
5098:+
5099:+The two statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
5100:+blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
5101:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
5102:+The canonical representative map is blueprint
5103:+`def:line-representative`; the coordinate blocks are those of
5104:+blueprint `def:combine-map`.
5106:+
5107:+open scoped BigOperators
5108:+
5109:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5110:+
5111:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
5112:+
5113:+noncomputable section
5114:+
5115:+/-! ## The canonical representative for the zero direction -/
5116:+
5117:+/-- For the zero direction the canonical representative map of
5118:+`def:line-representative` is the identity, since the span of the zero vector
5119:+is trivial.  Blueprint `def:line-representative`, paper
5120:+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174`.
5122:+theorem lineRepMap_zero_apply {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
5123:+    (u : Fin m → K) : lineRepMap (0 : Fin m → K) u = u := by
5124:+  have hspan : Submodule.span K ({0} : Set (Fin m → K)) = ⊥ := by simp
5125:+  have h := sub_lineRepMap_mem_span (0 : Fin m → K) u
5126:+  rw [hspan, Submodule.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at h
5127:+  exact h.symm
5128:+
5129:+/-! ## Uniform points of a line -/
5130:+
5131:+/-- The point at a uniformly random affine parameter on the line through the
5132:+canonical representative of a uniformly random point is uniformly random on
5133:+the whole coordinate space.  Every fiber of the parameterization has exactly
5134:+`q` elements: for a nonzero direction the parameter is determined and the
5135:+representative varies over a coset of the span of the direction, and for the
5136:+zero direction the representative is the point itself and the parameter is
5137:+free.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
5138:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
5139:+theorem uniformDistribution_map_lineRepMap_add_smul {K : Type*} [Field K]
5140:+    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) :
5141:+    (uniformDistribution ((Fin m → K) × K)).map
5142:+        (fun w => lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v) =
5143:+      uniformDistribution (Fin m → K) := by
5144:+  refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card K) fun x => ?_
5145:+  by_cases hv : v = 0
5146:+  · subst hv
5147:+    have hfilter :
5148:+        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin m → K) × K)).filter
5149:+            fun w => lineRepMap (0 : Fin m → K) w.1 + w.2 • (0 : Fin m → K)
5150:+              = x)
5151:+          = ({x} : Finset (Fin m → K)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset K) := by
5152:+      ext w
5153:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
5154:+        Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_singleton, and_true, smul_zero,
5155:+        add_zero, lineRepMap_zero_apply]
5156:+    rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
5157:+    simp
5158:+  · have hinj : Function.Injective
5159:+        (fun c : K => (lineRepMap v x + c • v, directLineRepParameter v x)) := by
5160:+      intro c₁ c₂ hc
5161:+      have hc' : c₁ • v = c₂ • v := by
5162:+        have h := congrArg Prod.fst hc
5163:+        simpa using h
5164:+      have hsub : (c₁ - c₂) • v = 0 := by
5165:+        rw [sub_smul, hc', sub_self]
5166:+      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hsub with h | h
5167:+      · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
5168:+      · exact absurd h hv
5169:+    have himg :
5170:+        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin m → K) × K)).filter
5171:+            fun w => lineRepMap v w.1 + w.2 • v = x)
5172:+          = (Finset.univ : Finset K).image
5173:+              (fun c => (lineRepMap v x + c • v,
5174:+                directLineRepParameter v x)) := by
5175:+      ext w
5176:+      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
5177:+      constructor
5178:+      · intro hw
5179:+        have hrep : lineRepMap v w.1 = lineRepMap v x := by
5180:+          rw [← hw, lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self]
5181:+        have hx : x = lineRepMap v x + w.2 • v := by
5182:+          rw [← hrep]
5183:+          exact hw.symm
5184:+        have ht : directLineRepParameter v x = w.2 :=
5185:+          directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero hv hx
5186:+        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp
5187:+          (sub_lineRepMap_mem_span v w.1)
5188:+        refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
5189:+        have hw1 : lineRepMap v x + c • v = w.1 := by
5190:+          rw [← hrep, hc]
5191:+          abel
5192:+        rw [Prod.ext_iff]
5193:+        exact ⟨hw1, ht⟩
5194:+      · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
5195:+        show lineRepMap v (lineRepMap v x + c • v) +
5196:+          directLineRepParameter v x • v = x
5197:+        rw [lineRepMap_add_smul, lineRepMap_apply_self]
5198:+        exact (directLineRepParameter_spec v x).symm
5199:+    rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ]
5200:+
5201:+/-! ## Injectivity of the two block embeddings -/
5202:+
5203:+/-- The `X`-block coordinate embedding of `def:combine-map` is injective.
5204:+Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
5205:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/

5453:+/-!
5454:+# Uniform collision bounds on nondegenerate affine lines
5455:+
5456:+This module combines uniqueness of affine evaluation with the univariate
5457:+root-count bound to control collisions under a uniform line parameter.
5458:+
5459:+## References
5460:+
5461:+The result is the Schwartz--Zippel step in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
5462:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-955`.

5465:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5466:+
5467:+open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
5468:+
5469:+noncomputable section
5470:+
5471:+/-- On a nondegenerate line, completed evaluations of distinct degree-bounded
5472:+polynomials collide with probability at most the degree bound divided by the
5473:+field size under a uniform affine parameter. -/
5474:+theorem evalOpt_uniform_parameter_collision_le {L : LdParams} {bound : ℕ}
5475:+    (line : LineDesc L) (hdir : line.direction ≠ 0)
5476:+    (first second : DegPoly L bound) (hne : first ≠ second) :
5477:+    avgOver (uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L)) (fun param =>
5478:+      if evalOpt line (line.base + param • line.direction) first =
5479:+        evalOpt line (line.base + param • line.direction) second then 1 else 0) ≤
5480:+      (bound : ℝ) / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
5481:+  classical
5482:+  simp_rw [evalOpt_affine_parameter_of_direction_ne_zero line hdir,
5483:+    Option.some.injEq]
5484:+  have hcard := evalCoefficient_collision_card_le first second hne
5485:+  unfold avgOver
5486:+  simp only [uniformDistribution_support, uniformDistribution_weight_apply,
5487:+    mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ← Finset.sum_filter]
5488:+  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div]
5489:+  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) (by positivity)
5490:+
5491:+end
5492:+
5493:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

5503:+/-!
5504:+# Weighted collision bounds for sampled lines
5505:+
5506:+This module lifts the uniform affine-parameter collision estimate to the mixed
5507:+line-point distribution with an arbitrary nonnegative weight depending only on
5508:+the sampled line.
5509:+
5510:+## References
5511:+
5512:+The estimate is the Schwartz--Zippel step in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
5513:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-955`.
5515:+
5516:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5517:+
5518:+open MIPStarRE.LDT
5519:+
5520:+noncomputable section
5521:+
5522:+/-- The collision bound remains valid with any nonnegative weight depending
5523:+only on the line, after restricting to nonzero directions. This proof-only
5524:+estimate is the conditional form of the root argument in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
5525:+paper lines 950--955; it does not assert the false unrestricted collision bound
5526:+on zero-direction coefficient presentations. -/
5527:+theorem linePointDist_nondegenerate_weighted_collision_le {L : LdParams}
5528:+    {bound : ℕ} (weight : LineDesc L → ℝ)
5529:+    (hweight : ∀ line, 0 ≤ weight line) (first second : DegPoly L bound)
5530:+    (hne : first ≠ second) :
5531:+    avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
5532:+      if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then weight sample.1 *
5533:+        (if evalOpt sample.1 sample.2 first = evalOpt sample.1 sample.2 second
5534:+          then 1 else 0) else 0) ≤
5535:+      (bound : ℝ) / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) *
5536:+        avgOver (linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
5537:+          if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then weight sample.1 else 0) := by
5538:+  classical
5539:+  rw [avgOver_linePointDist_resample_parameter]
5540:+  rw [← avgOver_const_mul]
5541:+  apply avgOver_mono
5542:+  intro sample
5543:+  by_cases hdir : sample.1.direction ≠ 0
5544:+  · simp only [if_pos hdir]
5545:+    rw [avgOver_const_mul]
5546:+    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
5547:+      (evalOpt_uniform_parameter_collision_le sample.1 hdir first second hne)
5548:+      (hweight sample.1)).trans_eq
5549:+      (mul_comm _ _)
5550:+  · simp [hdir, avgOver]
5551:+
5552:+end
5553:+
5554:+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

5751:+/-!
5752:+# Closeness estimates for the combined point measurements
5753:+
5754:+Given projective measurements `Q^{x,z}` on each player's expanded local space
5755:+that are close to the sandwich POVMs on the placements where they were
5756:+constructed, this file assembles the three conclusions of `lem:qld-4-10` on
5757:+every pair of opposite placements by the triangle inequality along
5758:+`Q ≈ R ≈ M^Z M^X ≈ M^X M^Z` and the cross-placement consistency of the
5759:+ordered products.  It also records the trivial bound `4` on the state-dependent
5760:+distance of two square-summable families, used when the test error exceeds
5761:+one, and the elementary estimate collapsing the error terms `ε`, `√ε`, and
5762:+`(ε + √ε)^{1/4}` into a single power `ε^{1/8}` when `ε ≤ 1`.
5763:+
5764:+## References
5765:+
5766:+Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:838-881`
5767:+(self-consistency and consistency with `M̂` in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`),
5768:+blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:803-960`; the route
5769:+is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
5771:+
5772:+open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
5773:+
5774:+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
5775:+

5781:+/-! ## The trivial bound -/
5782:+
5783:+/-- A square-summable family of operators has total squared norm at most one on
5784:+a unit vector. -/
5785:+theorem sum_norm_apply_sq_le_one {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]
5786:+    [DecidableEq ι] (A : α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
5787:+    (hA : ∑ a, (A a)ᴴ * A a ≤ 1) :
5788:+    ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
5789:+  have h := sum_norm_mul_apply_le A 1 ψ hA
5790:+  simp only [mul_one, WinImplications.applyOperatorToState_one, hψ] at h
5791:+  simpa using h
5792:+
5793:+/-- The state-dependent distance of two square-summable families is at most
5794:+`4` on a unit vector, under a uniform distribution. -/
5795:+theorem opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four {X α ι : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
5796:+    [Nonempty X] [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
5797:+    (A B : X → α → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
5798:+    (hA : ∀ x, ∑ a, (A x a)ᴴ * A x a ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ x, ∑ a, (B x a)ᴴ * B x a ≤ 1) :
5799:+    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution X) A B ψ ≤ 4 := by
5800:+  unfold opFamilyDistSq
5801:+  calc avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
5802:+        ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2)
5803:+      ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun _ => (4 : ℝ)) := by
5804:+        refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun x => ?_
5805:+        have hA' := sum_norm_apply_sq_le_one (A x) ψ hψ (hA x)
5806:+        have hB' := sum_norm_apply_sq_le_one (B x) ψ hψ (hB x)
5807:+        have hpt : ∀ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
5808:+            2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
5809:+              2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
5810:+          intro a
5811:+          have hsub : applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ =
5812:+              applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ - applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ := by
5813:+            simp [applyOperatorToState]
5814:+          rw [hsub]
5815:+          have := norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ)
5816:+            (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ)
5817:+          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ),
5818:+            norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ),
5819:+            norm_nonneg (applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ -
5820:+              applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ),
5821:+            sq_nonneg (‖applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ‖ -
5822:+              ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ‖)]
5823:+        calc ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a - B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2
5824:+            ≤ ∑ a, (2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
5825:+                2 * ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2) :=
5826:+              Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => hpt a
5827:+          _ = 2 * ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
5828:+                2 * ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (B x a) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
5829:+              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
5830:+          _ ≤ 4 := by linarith
5831:+    _ = 4 := avgOver_uniform_const _

5833:+/-- The effects of a projective measurement, placed on a register pair, are
5834:+square-summable to the identity. -/
5835:+theorem ProjectiveSetting.sum_place_effect_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one
5836:+    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : Placement)
5837:+    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
5838:+    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
5839:+    ∑ a, (S.place p (M.effect a))ᴴ * S.place p (M.effect a) ≤ 1 := by
5840:+  refine le_of_eq ?_
5841:+  calc ∑ a, (S.place p (M.effect a))ᴴ * S.place p (M.effect a)
5842:+      = ∑ a, S.place p (M.effect a) := by
5843:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
5844:+        rw [← S.place_conjTranspose, ← S.place_mul,
5845:+          (hM a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
5846:+    _ = 1 := by rw [← S.place_finsetSum, M.sum_eq_one, S.place_one]
5847:+
5848:+/-- The products `A_a B_b` of the effects of two projective measurements on a
5849:+common space are square-summable to the identity. -/
5850:+theorem sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
5851:+    [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
5852:+    (A : Measurement α ι) (B : Measurement β ι)
5853:+    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
5854:+    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
5855:+    ∑ ab : α × β, (A.effect ab.1 * B.effect ab.2)ᴴ * (A.effect ab.1 * B.effect ab.2) =
5856:+      1 := by
5857:+  have hpt : ∀ (a : α) (b : β),
5858:+      (A.effect a * B.effect b)ᴴ * (A.effect a * B.effect b) =
5859:+        B.effect b * A.effect a * B.effect b := by
5860:+    intro a b
5861:+    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
5862:+      (hB b).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ (A.effect a * B.effect b),
5863:+      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (A.effect a) (A.effect a), (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq,
5864:+      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
5865:+  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
5866:+  calc ∑ b : β, ∑ a : α, (A.effect a * B.effect b)ᴴ * (A.effect a * B.effect b)
5867:+      = ∑ b : β, B.effect b * (∑ a : α, A.effect a) * B.effect b := by
5868:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
5869:+        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
5870:+        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hpt a b
5871:+    _ = 1 := by
5872:+        simp_rw [A.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
5873:+        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => (hB b).isIdempotentElem.eq]
5874:+        exact B.sum_eq_one
5875:+
5876:+/-- The products `B_b A_a` of the effects of two projective measurements on a
5877:+common space, indexed by the pair `(a, b)`, are square-summable to the
5878:+identity. -/
5879:+theorem sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one' {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
5880:+    [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
5881:+    (A : Measurement α ι) (B : Measurement β ι)
5882:+    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
5883:+    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
5884:+    ∑ ab : α × β, (B.effect ab.2 * A.effect ab.1)ᴴ * (B.effect ab.2 * A.effect ab.1) =
5885:+      1 := by
5886:+  have hpt : ∀ (a : α) (b : β),
5887:+      (B.effect b * A.effect a)ᴴ * (B.effect b * A.effect a) =
5888:+        A.effect a * B.effect b * A.effect a := by
5889:+    intro a b
5890:+    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (hA a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
5891:+      (hB b).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ (B.effect b * A.effect a),
5892:+      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (B.effect b) (B.effect b), (hB b).isIdempotentElem.eq,
5893:+      ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
5894:+  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
5895:+  calc ∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, (B.effect b * A.effect a)ᴴ * (B.effect b * A.effect a)
5896:+      = ∑ a : α, A.effect a * (∑ b : β, B.effect b) * A.effect a := by
5897:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
5898:+        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
5899:+        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hpt a b
5900:+    _ = 1 := by
5901:+        simp_rw [B.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
5902:+        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => (hA a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
5903:+        exact A.sum_eq_one

5911:+/-- The three closeness conclusions of `lem:qld-4-10` for a pair of projective
5912:+families close to the placed sandwiches: with `η` the closeness of `Q` to `R`
5913:+on every placement, `C₁ √ε` the closeness of `R` to the ordered product,
5914:+`C₂ √ε` the commutation error, and `C₃ ε` the cross-placement consistency of
5915:+the ordered products, the distances from `Q` on one placement to the two
5916:+ordered products and to `Q` on the opposite placement are bounded by explicit
5917:+combinations.  Paper
5918:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:838-881`. -/
5919:+theorem chain_bounds (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
5920:+    (Q : (side : PlayerSide) → PointPair P →
5921:+      Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side))
5922:+    (η C₁ C₂ C₃ : ℝ)
5923:+    (hQR : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5924:+      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
5925:+        S.place p ((Q p.side xz).effect ab))
5926:+      (fun xz ab => S.place p ((S.sandwichPoint p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
5927:+      S.psiHat ≤ η)
5928:+    (h₁ : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5929:+      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
5930:+        S.place p ((S.sandwichPoint p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
5931:+      (fun xz ab => S.place p
5932:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5933:+          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5934:+      S.psiHat ≤ C₁ * Real.sqrt ε)
5935:+    (h₂ : ∀ p : Placement, opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5936:+      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p
5937:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
5938:+          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
5939:+      (fun xz ab => S.place p
5940:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5941:+          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5942:+      S.psiHat ≤ C₂ * Real.sqrt ε)
5943:+    (h₃ : ∀ p₁ p₂ : Placement, p₁.IsOpposite p₂ →
5944:+      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5945:+        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p₁
5946:+          ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5947:+            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5948:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
5949:+          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
5950:+            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
5951:+        S.psiHat ≤ C₃ * ε)
5952:+    (p₁ p₂ : Placement) (hopp : p₁.IsOpposite p₂) :
5953:+    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5954:+        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
5955:+          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
5956:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
5957:+          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
5958:+            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
5959:+        S.psiHat ≤ 2 * η + 4 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 4 * (C₃ * ε) ∧
5960:+      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5961:+        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
5962:+          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
5963:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂
5964:+          ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5965:+            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5966:+        S.psiHat ≤ 4 * η + 8 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 8 * (C₃ * ε) +
5967:+          2 * (C₂ * Real.sqrt ε) ∧
5968:+      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5969:+        (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
5970:+          S.place p₁ ((Q p₁.side xz).effect ab))
5971:+        (fun xz ab => S.place p₂ ((Q p₂.side xz).effect ab))
5972:+        S.psiHat ≤ 12 * η + 20 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) + 16 * (C₃ * ε) +
5973:+          4 * (C₂ * Real.sqrt ε) := by
5974:+  -- `R_1 ≈ M^X M^Z` on the opposite placement
5975:+  have hRXZ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5976:+    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (h₁ p₁) (h₃ p₁ p₂ hopp)
5977:+  -- `Q_1 ≈ M^X M^Z` on the opposite placement
5978:+  have hQXZ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5979:+    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (hQR p₁) hRXZ
5980:+  -- `Q_1 ≈ M^Z M^X` on the opposite placement
5981:+  have hQZX := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5982:+    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hQXZ (h₂ p₂)
5983:+  -- `M^Z M^X ≈ Q_2` on the opposite placement
5984:+  have hZXQ : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5985:+      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p₂
5986:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
5987:+          (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
5988:+      (fun xz ab => S.place p₂ ((Q p₂.side xz).effect ab))
5989:+      S.psiHat ≤ 2 * η + 2 * (C₁ * Real.sqrt ε) := by
5990:+    rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm]
5991:+    exact opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5992:+      _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ (hQR p₂) (h₁ p₂)
5993:+  have hQQ := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
5994:+    _ _ _ S.psiHat _ _ hQZX hZXQ
5995:+  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
5996:+
5997:+end ProjectiveSetting

5999:+/-! ## Collapsing the error terms into one power -/
6000:+
6001:+/-- For `0 ≤ ε ≤ 1`, the error terms `ε`, `√ε`, and `(C₀ (ε + √ε))^{1/4}`
6002:+with `C₀ ≥ 1` are all bounded by multiples of `ε^{1/8}`. -/
6003:+theorem error_terms_le_rpow_eighth {ε C₀ : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
6004:+    (hC₀ : 1 ≤ C₀) :
6005:+    ε ≤ Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) ∧ Real.sqrt ε ≤ Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) ∧
6006:+      Real.rpow (C₀ * (ε + Real.sqrt ε)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
6007:+        2 * C₀ * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
6008:+  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hε with h0 | hpos
6009:+  · subst h0
6010:+    have h8 : Real.rpow (0 : ℝ) (1 / 8 : ℝ) = 0 := Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)
6011:+    have h4 : Real.rpow (C₀ * (0 + Real.sqrt 0)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) = 0 := by
6012:+      rw [Real.sqrt_zero, add_zero, mul_zero]
6013:+      exact Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)
6014:+    rw [h8, h4, Real.sqrt_zero]
6015:+    refine ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
6016:+    positivity
6017:+  · have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ε = Real.rpow ε (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow ε
6018:+    have hε1' : Real.rpow ε 1 = ε := Real.rpow_one ε
6019:+    have hmono : ∀ y z : ℝ, z ≤ y → Real.rpow ε y ≤ Real.rpow ε z := fun y z hyz =>
6020:+      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hpos hε1 hyz
6021:+    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
6022:+    · exact le_of_eq_of_le hε1'.symm (hmono 1 (1 / 8) (by norm_num))
6023:+    · rw [hsqrt]
6024:+      exact hmono (1 / 2) (1 / 8) (by norm_num)
6025:+    · have hsum : ε + Real.sqrt ε ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ε := by
6026:+        have : ε ≤ Real.sqrt ε := by
6027:+          rw [hsqrt]
6028:+          exact le_of_eq_of_le hε1'.symm (hmono 1 (1 / 2) (by norm_num))
6029:+        linarith
6030:+      have hC : 0 ≤ 2 * C₀ := by linarith
6031:+      calc Real.rpow (C₀ * (ε + Real.sqrt ε)) (1 / 4 : ℝ)
6032:+          ≤ Real.rpow (2 * C₀ * Real.sqrt ε) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
6033:+            apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) _ (by norm_num)
6034:+            nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg ε]
6035:+        _ = Real.rpow (2 * C₀) (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
6036:+            change (2 * C₀ * Real.sqrt ε) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) =
6037:+              (2 * C₀) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ε ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)
6038:+            rw [Real.mul_rpow hC (Real.sqrt_nonneg ε), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
6039:+              ← Real.rpow_mul hε]
6040:+            norm_num
6041:+        _ ≤ 2 * C₀ * Real.rpow ε (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
6042:+            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_nonneg hε _)
6043:+            calc Real.rpow (2 * C₀) (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.rpow (2 * C₀) 1 :=
6044:+                  Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by norm_num)
6045:+              _ = 2 * C₀ := Real.rpow_one _
6046:+
6047:+end

6061:+The approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons` is stated for the binary
6062:+refinements `M^{(Point,W),u,r}_b` of the expanded point measurements.  The
6063:+combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10` are built here directly from the
6064:+`F_q`-valued measurements `M^{(Point,W),u}_a`, so the commutation estimate is
6065:+transferred to them.  The transfer is exact: since
6066:+`M^{(Point,X),x}_a = E_r (-1)^{tr(ar)} X^r(x)` and
6067:+`M^{(Point,Z),z}_b = E_s (-1)^{tr(bs)} Z^s(z)`, the commutator of the two
6068:+measurement effects is the Fourier transform, in the outcome pair `(a, b)`,
6069:+of the commutators of the expanded observables, and Parseval's identity for
6070:+the additive characters of `F_q` turns the sum over `(a, b)` of the squared
6071:+norms into the average over `(r, s)` of the squared norms of the observable
6072:+commutators.  No factor depending on `q` is lost.
6073:+
6074:+## Main results
6075:+
6076:+* `sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal`: Parseval's identity for an orthogonal
6077:+  system of coefficients.
6078:+* `sum_fixedCharacter_mul`: Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character.
6079:+* `expPoint_comm`: the field-valued expanded point measurements approximately
6080:+  commute on every register placement, with the error of
6081:+  `lem:qld-comm-cons`.
6082:+
6083:+## References
6084:+
6085:+The commutation estimate for the binary refinements is item 2 of
6086:+`lem:qld-comm-cons`, blueprint
6087:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1210`, paper
6088:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`; the
6089:+Fourier form of the point effects is `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
6090:+lines 384--418.  The role of the transfer in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` is
6091:+explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.

6110:+/-! ## Parseval's identity for an orthogonal system of coefficients -/
6111:+
6112:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:qld-4-10`: if the coefficient
6113:+vectors `j ↦ c j i`, indexed by `i`, are orthogonal with common squared norm
6114:+`N`, then the squared norms of the weighted sums
6115:+`∑ i, c j i • v i` add up to `N` times the squared norms of the `v i`. -/
6116:+theorem sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal {I J E : Type*} [Fintype I]
6117:+    [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
6118:+    (c : J → I → ℂ) (N : ℝ)
6119:+    (horth : ∀ i i', ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i' =
6120:+      if i = i' then (N : ℂ) else 0)
6121:+    (v : I → E) :
6122:+    ∑ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2 = N * ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 := by
6123:+  have hnorm : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℂ x x).re := fun x => by
6124:+    simpa using (inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) x).symm
6125:+  have hj : ∀ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2 =
6126:+      (∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
6127:+        inner ℂ (v i) (v i')).re := by
6128:+    intro j
6129:+    rw [hnorm, sum_inner]
6130:+    simp only [inner_sum, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right]
6131:+    congr 1
6132:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
6133:+    ring
6134:+  have hsum : ∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
6135:+      inner ℂ (v i) (v i') = ∑ i, (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i) := by
6136:+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
6137:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
6138:+    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
6139:+    calc ∑ i', ∑ j, ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') * inner ℂ (v i) (v i')
6140:+        = ∑ i', (∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
6141:+            inner ℂ (v i) (v i') := by
6142:+          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
6143:+          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
6144:+      _ = ∑ i', (if i = i' then (N : ℂ) else 0) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i') := by
6145:+          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
6146:+          rw [horth]
6147:+      _ = (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i) := by
6148:+          simp [ite_mul]
6149:+  calc ∑ j, ‖∑ i, c j i • v i‖ ^ 2
6150:+      = (∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ i', ((starRingEnd ℂ) (c j i) * c j i') *
6151:+          inner ℂ (v i) (v i')).re := by
6152:+        rw [Complex.re_sum]
6153:+        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hj j
6154:+    _ = (∑ i, (N : ℂ) * inner ℂ (v i) (v i)).re := by rw [hsum]
6155:+    _ = N * ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 := by
6156:+        rw [Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
6157:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
6158:+        rw [Complex.re_ofReal_mul, ← hnorm]

6160:+/-! ## The fixed trace character -/
6161:+
6162:+section Characters
6163:+
6164:+variable {P : AdmissibleParams}
6165:+
6166:+/-- The phase induced by the fixed binary trace is an additive character.
6167:+Paper `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1081`. -/
6168:+theorem fixedCharacter_mul (x y : PauliScalar P) :
6169:+    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model x) * phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model y) =
6170:+      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (x + y)) := by
6171:+  rw [fixedBinTrace, map_add, phaseSign_eq_ffChar, phaseSign_eq_ffChar,
6172:+    phaseSign_eq_ffChar]
6173:+  exact ((ZMod.stdAddChar (N := 2)).map_add_eq_mul _ _).symm
6174:+
6175:+/-- The fixed trace character is even: negation acts trivially on the binary
6176:+trace. -/
6177:+theorem fixedCharacter_neg (x : PauliScalar P) :
6178:+    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (-x)) =
6179:+      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model x) := by
6180:+  rw [fixedBinTrace, map_neg, ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two]
6181:+
6182:+/-- Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character: the character sums to
6183:+the field size at `0` and to zero elsewhere.  This is `lem:cancellation` for
6184:+the one-dimensional space, blueprint
6185:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:686`, paper
6186:+`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1124-1132`. -/
6187:+theorem sum_fixedCharacter_mul (c : PauliScalar P) :
6188:+    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * c)) =
6189:+      if c = 0 then (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) else 0 := by
6190:+  have h : (𝔼 r : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (r * c))) =
6191:+      if c = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
6192:+    simpa only [fixedBinTrace, phaseSign_eq_ffChar,
6193:+      MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar_apply] using
6194:+      (fourier_fact_scalar (p := 2) (F := PauliScalar P) c)
6195:+  rw [Finset.expect_eq_sum_div_card] at h
6196:+  have hcard : (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
6197:+    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
6198:+  rw [Finset.card_univ, div_eq_iff hcard] at h
6199:+  rw [h]
6200:+  split_ifs <;> simp
6201:+
6202:+/-- Orthogonality of two fixed trace characters. -/
6203:+theorem sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter (r r' : PauliScalar P) :
6204:+    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) *
6205:+        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r')) =
6206:+      if r = r' then (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ) else 0 := by
6207:+  have hterm : ∀ a : PauliScalar P,
6208:+      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) *
6209:+          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r')) =
6210:+        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * (r' - r))) := by
6211:+    intro a
6212:+    rw [← fixedCharacter_neg (a * r), fixedCharacter_mul]
6213:+    congr 2
6214:+    ring
6215:+  simp_rw [hterm, sum_fixedCharacter_mul]
6216:+  by_cases h : r = r'
6217:+  · simp [h]
6218:+  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg]
6219:+    intro h'
6220:+    exact h (sub_eq_zero.mp h').symm
6221:+
6222:+/-- The two-dimensional character system `(a, b) ↦ χ(a r) χ(b s)` is orthogonal
6223:+with common squared norm `q ^ 2`. -/
6224:+theorem sum_pairCharacter_mul_pairCharacter
6225:+    (rs rs' : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) :
6226:+    ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6227:+        (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs.1)) *
6228:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs.2))) *
6229:+          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs'.1)) *
6230:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs'.2))) =
6231:+      if rs = rs' then
6232:+        (((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0 := by
6233:+  have hstar : ∀ t : ZMod 2, (starRingEnd ℂ) (phaseSign t) = phaseSign t := by
6234:+    intro t
6235:+    rw [← Complex.star_def]
6236:+    exact star_phaseSign t
6237:+  simp_rw [map_mul, hstar]
6238:+  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
6239:+  calc ∑ a : PauliScalar P, ∑ b : PauliScalar P,
6240:+        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs.1)) *
6241:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs.2)) *
6242:+          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs'.1)) *
6243:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs'.2)))
6244:+      = (∑ a : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs.1)) *
6245:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs'.1))) *
6246:+          ∑ b : PauliScalar P, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs.2)) *
6247:+            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs'.2)) := by
6248:+        rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
6249:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
6250:+        ring
6251:+    _ = _ := by
6252:+        rw [sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter,
6253:+          sum_fixedCharacter_mul_fixedCharacter]
6254:+        by_cases h1 : rs.1 = rs'.1 <;> by_cases h2 : rs.2 = rs'.2
6255:+        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_pos (Prod.ext h1 h2)]
6256:+          push_cast
6257:+          ring
6258:+        · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h2 (congrArg Prod.snd h))]
6259:+          simp
6260:+        · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, if_neg (fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h))]
6261:+          simp
6262:+        · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h1 (congrArg Prod.fst h))]
6263:+          simp
6264:+
6265:+end Characters

6269:+/-- A uniform operator average is the normalized sum. -/
6270:+theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_eq_inv_card_smul_sum
6271:+    {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
6272:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : α → Op ι) :
6273:+    averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution α) f =
6274:+      (Fintype.card α : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ a, f a := by
6275:+  ext i j
6276:+  simp only [averageOperatorOverDistribution, uniformDistribution,
6277:+    Distribution.uniformOnFinset, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Matrix.sum_apply,
6278:+    Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul,
6279:+    Finset.card_univ, one_div, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast]
6280:+  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

6282:+namespace ProjectiveSetting
6283:+
6284:+variable {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
6285:+
6286:+/-- The Fourier form of an expanded point effect as a normalized character
6287:+sum of the expanded observables.  This is the first display of
6288:+`def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
6289:+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`. -/
6290:+theorem expPointOp_eq_inv_card_smul_sum (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
6291:+    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
6292:+    (a : PauliScalar P) :
6293:+    S.expPointOp side W u a =
6294:+      (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
6295:+        ∑ r, phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) • S.expObs side W r u := by
6296:+  unfold expPointOp
6297:+  rw [averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_eq_inv_card_smul_sum]
6298:+
6299:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the product of two normalized weighted sums
6300:+is the normalized double sum of the weighted products, indexed by pairs. -/
6301:+theorem smul_sum_mul_smul_sum {ι K : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype ι]
6302:+    (c : ℂ) (α β : K → ℂ) (X Z : K → Op ι) :
6303:+    (c • ∑ r, α r • X r) * (c • ∑ s, β s • Z s) =
6304:+      (c * c) • ∑ rs : K × K, (α rs.1 * β rs.2) • (X rs.1 * Z rs.2) := by
6305:+  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, smul_mul_smul_comm, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
6306:+  congr 1
6307:+  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
6308:+  rw [smul_mul_smul_comm]
6309:+
6310:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the product of two normalized weighted sums
6311:+in the opposite order, indexed by the same pairs. -/
6312:+theorem smul_sum_mul_smul_sum_swap {ι K : Type*} [Fintype K] [Fintype ι]
6313:+    (c : ℂ) (α β : K → ℂ) (X Z : K → Op ι) :
6314:+    (c • ∑ s, β s • Z s) * (c • ∑ r, α r • X r) =
6315:+      (c * c) • ∑ rs : K × K, (α rs.1 * β rs.2) • (Z rs.2 * X rs.1) := by
6316:+  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right, smul_mul_smul_comm, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
6317:+  congr 1
6318:+  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
6319:+  rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_comm (β s)]
6320:+
6321:+/-- The commutator of two field-valued point effects is the Fourier transform
6322:+of the commutators of the expanded observables. -/
6323:+theorem expPointOp_commutator_eq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
6324:+    (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (a b : PauliScalar P) :
6325:+    S.expPointOp side .X x a * S.expPointOp side .Z z b -
6326:+        S.expPointOp side .Z z b * S.expPointOp side .X x a =
6327:+      ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
6328:+          (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ)⁻¹) •
6329:+        ∑ rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6330:+          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (a * rs.1)) *
6331:+              phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (b * rs.2))) •
6332:+            (S.expObs side .X rs.1 x * S.expObs side .Z rs.2 z -
6333:+              S.expObs side .Z rs.2 z * S.expObs side .X rs.1 x) := by
6334:+  rw [expPointOp_eq_inv_card_smul_sum, expPointOp_eq_inv_card_smul_sum,
6335:+    smul_sum_mul_smul_sum, smul_sum_mul_smul_sum_swap, ← smul_sub,
6336:+    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
6337:+  congr 1
6338:+  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rs _ => ?_
6339:+  rw [smul_sub]
6340:+
6341:+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: an operator applied to a state is linear in
6342:+the operator over finite sums. -/
6343:+theorem applyOperatorToState_finsetSum {ι γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6344:+    (s : Finset γ) (M : γ → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
6345:+    applyOperatorToState (∑ x ∈ s, M x) ψ =
6346:+      ∑ x ∈ s, applyOperatorToState (M x) ψ := by
6347:+  unfold applyOperatorToState
6348:+  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
6349:+
6350:+/-- Parseval transfer, pointwise in the point pair: the summed squared norms of
6351:+the placed commutators of the field-valued point effects equal the average over
6352:+`(r, s)` of the squared norms of the placed commutators of the expanded
6353:+observables. -/
6354:+theorem sum_norm_place_expPointOp_commutator_sq (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
6355:+    (p : Placement) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) :
6356:+    ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6357:+        ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6358:+          (S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1 * S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 -
6359:+            S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 * S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1))
6360:+          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 =
6361:+      avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P))
6362:+        (fun rs => ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6363:+          (S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x * S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z -
6364:+            S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z * S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x))
6365:+          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) := by
6366:+  set v : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P →
6367:+      EuclideanSpace ℂ (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
6368:+    fun rs => applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6369:+      (S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x * S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z -
6370:+        S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z * S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x)) S.psiHat
6371:+  set c : ℂ := (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℂ)⁻¹
6372:+  have hpt : ∀ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6373:+      applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6374:+          (S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1 * S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 -
6375:+            S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 * S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1))
6376:+          S.psiHat =
6377:+        (c * c) • ∑ rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6378:+          (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs.1)) *
6379:+              phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs.2))) • v rs := by
6380:+    intro ab
6381:+    rw [expPointOp_commutator_eq, place_smul, place_finsetSum,
6382:+      WinImplications.applyOperatorToState_smul_op, applyOperatorToState_finsetSum]
6383:+    congr 1
6384:+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rs _ => ?_
6385:+    rw [place_smul, WinImplications.applyOperatorToState_smul_op]
6386:+  have hparseval := sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal
6387:+    (fun (ab rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
6388:+      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs.1)) *
6389:+        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs.2)))
6390:+    ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) ^ 2)
6391:+    (fun rs rs' => sum_pairCharacter_mul_pairCharacter rs rs') v
6392:+  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) := by
6393:+    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
6394:+  have hcnorm : ‖c * c‖ = ((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
6395:+    simp only [c, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
6396:+    rw [sq, mul_inv]
6397:+  calc ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6398:+        ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6399:+          (S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1 * S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 -
6400:+            S.expPointOp p.side .Z z ab.2 * S.expPointOp p.side .X x ab.1))
6401:+          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2
6402:+      = ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6403:+          ‖c * c‖ ^ 2 * ‖∑ rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6404:+            (phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.1 * rs.1)) *
6405:+              phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (ab.2 * rs.2))) • v rs‖ ^ 2 := by
6406:+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ab _ => ?_
6407:+        rw [hpt, norm_smul, mul_pow]
6408:+    _ = ‖c * c‖ ^ 2 * (((Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
6409:+          ∑ rs, ‖v rs‖ ^ 2) := by
6410:+        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hparseval]
6411:+    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P))
6412:+          (fun rs => ‖v rs‖ ^ 2) := by
6413:+        rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_prod, hcnorm]
6414:+        push_cast
6415:+        field_simp
6416:+
6417:+/-- The field-valued expanded point measurements approximately commute on each
6418:+of the four register placements, with the error of item 2 of
6419:+`lem:qld-comm-cons`.  The estimate is transferred from the binary refinements

6424:+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`. -/

6426:+    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
6427:+      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
6428:+        (p : Placement),
6429:+        opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
6430:+          (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p
6431:+            ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
6432:+              (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
6433:+          (fun xz ab => S.place p
6434:+            ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
6435:+              (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
6436:+          S.psiHat ≤ C * Real.sqrt ε := by
6437:+  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := exists_twistedCommutator_avg_le
6438:+  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
6439:+  intro P ε S p
6440:+  have hε : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε := by
6441:+    have hv := WinImplications.strategy_value_le_one S.toStrategy
6442:+    have hw := S.win
6443:+    linarith
6444:+  have hnorm : ∀ (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
6445:+      (rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P),
6446:+      ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6447:+          (S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x * S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z -
6448:+            S.expObs p.side .Z rs.2 z * S.expObs p.side .X rs.1 x))
6449:+          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 =
6450:+        ‖applyOperatorToState
6451:+          (S.placeStrategySide p.side (S.twistedCommutator p.side (x, z, rs.1, rs.2)))
6452:+          S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
6453:+    intro x z rs
6454:+    rw [expObs_commutator S p.side (x, z, rs.1, rs.2),
6455:+      norm_place_heteroKron_psiHat S p _ _ (tauX_mul_tauZ_isometry P (x, z, rs.1, rs.2))]
6456:+  have hfamily : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
6457:+      (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => S.place p
6458:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
6459:+          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
6460:+      (fun xz ab => S.place p
6461:+        ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
6462:+          (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
6463:+      S.psiHat =
6464:+      avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliTuple P)) (fun ω =>
6465:+        ‖applyOperatorToState
6466:+          (S.placeStrategySide p.side (S.twistedCommutator p.side ω))
6467:+          S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
6468:+    unfold opFamilyDistSq
6469:+    calc avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
6470:+          ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P,
6471:+            ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p
6472:+                ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
6473:+                  (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
6474:+              S.place p ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
6475:+                (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)
6476:+        = avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
6477:+            avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P))
6478:+              (fun rs => ‖applyOperatorToState
6479:+                (S.placeStrategySide p.side
6480:+                  (S.twistedCommutator p.side (xz.1, xz.2, rs.1, rs.2)))
6481:+                S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2)) := by
6482:+          refine avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun xz => ?_
6483:+          rw [← avgOver_congr _ _ _ (hnorm xz.1 xz.2),
6484:+            ← sum_norm_place_expPointOp_commutator_sq S p xz.1 xz.2]
6485:+          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ab _ => ?_
6486:+          rw [place_sub]
6487:+          rfl
6488:+      _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P × (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P)))
6489:+            (fun q => ‖applyOperatorToState
6490:+              (S.placeStrategySide p.side
6491:+                (S.twistedCommutator p.side (q.1.1, q.1.2, q.2.1, q.2.2)))
6492:+              S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2) :=
6493:+          (avgOver_uniform_prod (fun (xz : PointPair P)
6494:+            (rs : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) => ‖applyOperatorToState
6495:+              (S.placeStrategySide p.side
6496:+                (S.twistedCommutator p.side (xz.1, xz.2, rs.1, rs.2)))
6497:+              S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2)).symm
6498:+      _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (PauliTuple P)) (fun ω =>
6499:+            ‖applyOperatorToState
6500:+              (S.placeStrategySide p.side (S.twistedCommutator p.side ω))
6501:+              S.toStrategy.ψ‖ ^ 2) := by
6502:+          rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (Equiv.prodAssoc (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)
6503:+            (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P))]
6504:+          rfl
6505:+  rw [hfamily]
6506:+  exact h P ε S p.side hε

6521:+/-!
6522:+# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM
6523:+
6524:+The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
6525:+`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
6526:+between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
6527:+Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
6528:+`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
6529:+`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
6530:+`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
6531:+consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
6532:+`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
6533:+by two applications of the identity
6534:+`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
6535:+measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
6536:+and the commutators on the two placements, since
6537:+`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
6538:+`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.
6539:+
6540:+## Main results
6541:+
6542:+* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
6543:+  placed sandwiches.
6544:+* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
6545:+  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
6546:+* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
6547:+  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
6548:+  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
6549:+  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.
6550:+
6551:+## References
6552:+
6553:+Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
6554:+blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
6555:+(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
6556:+`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.

6570:+/-- The quadratic form of `Wᴴ M W` in `ψ` is the quadratic form of `M` in
6571:+`W ψ`. -/
6572:+theorem stateQForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6573:+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W M : Op ι) :
6574:+    stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * M * W) = stateQForm (applyOperatorToState W ψ) M := by
6575:+  unfold stateQForm
6576:+  rw [DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul,
6577:+    DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul]
6578:+  congr 1
6579:+  change inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin Wᴴ _) =
6580:+    inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin W ψ) _
6581:+  rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint, LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
6582:+
6583:+/-- The squared norm of `W ψ` is the quadratic form of `Wᴴ W`. -/
6584:+theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sq_eq_stateQForm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
6585:+    [DecidableEq ι] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (W : Op ι) :
6586:+    ‖applyOperatorToState W ψ‖ ^ 2 = stateQForm ψ (Wᴴ * W) :=
6587:+  MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq W ψ
6588:+
6589:+/-- For two projective measurements, the diagonal overlap in a vector `w` is
6590:+the squared norm of `w` minus half the summed squared distances.  This is the
6591:+identity behind `fact:agreement` for projective families, blueprint
6592:+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:260-272`. -/
6593:+theorem sum_stateQForm_mul_eq_of_projective {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
6594:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
6595:+    (A B : Measurement α ι) (w : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι)
6596:+    (hA : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective A)
6597:+    (hB : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective B) :
6598:+    ∑ a, stateQForm w (A.effect a * B.effect a) =
6599:+      ‖w‖ ^ 2 -
6600:+        (1 / 2) * ∑ a, ‖applyOperatorToState (A.effect a - B.effect a) w‖ ^ 2 := by
6601:+  classical
6602:+  rw [point_distance_eq_two_defect_of_projective A B w hA hB, point_defect_eq]
6603:+  ring

6605:+/-- An effect of a projective measurement is a contraction. -/
6606:+theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_proj_effect_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
6607:+    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι)
6608:+    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) (a : α)
6609:+    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
6610:+    ‖applyOperatorToState (M.effect a) v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
6611:+  refine MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le ?_ v
6612:+  rw [(hM a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq, (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
6613:+  exact measurement_effect_le_one M a

6615:+/-- The effects of a projective measurement are square-summable to the
6616:+identity. -/
6617:+theorem sum_effect_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one_of_projective {α ι : Type*}
6618:+    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι)
6619:+    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
6620:+    ∑ a, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
